answer: Each epoch a lantern is broadcast to every seat at once: a fresh puzzle needing 30 GPU-seconds, due within 40 seconds, so one GPU cannot answer for two seats. The tundra times each reply from six continents and records its latency pattern as that seat's ripple. Seats whose ripple matches within 3 ms share a site, and the k-th seat at a site receives a lantern 3^(k-1) times larger. A lone agent spends 30 GPU-seconds per epoch. Ten clones in one rack need 885,720, or real hardware rented in ten separate cities.
